summary.text: Erin Feichtinger is a nonpartisan candidate for the Nebraska Legislature, District 8, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She served on the Metropolitan Community College Board of Governors, District 2, from 2019 to January 5, 2023.

paragraphs.text: Feichtinger won the Metropolitan Community College Board of Governors District 2 seat in the November 6, 2018 general election, defeating incumbent Brad Ashby.
She lost re-election to Tammy Wright on November 8, 2022, and left office on January 5, 2023.
She advanced from the May 12, 2026 primary for the Nebraska Legislature, District 8, and faces Josh Livingston in a race with no incumbent.
